extras.document_section: S3-compatible object storage below the big three
extras.verified_at_basis: the seed research pass, which ended 2026-10-21; this record was not re-checked against the live service
extras.quota_verbatim: Up to 100 buckets, each up to 100 TB / 50 million objects; 5 TB max per object; regions FSN1/HEL1/NBG1
extras.limits_verbatim: Base price EUR 6.49/mo billed hourly at EUR 0.0104/h, charged for every hour a bucket exists even if empty. Storage overage EUR 0.0087 per TB-hour (= EUR 6.35/TB/month). Minimum billable object size 64 KB — pathological for small files.
extras.egress_verbatim: Base price includes 1 TB/month egress (1.1160 TB in a 31-day month, accumulated hourly). Overage verbatim: "Egress traffic: EUR 1.0000 per hour... per TB". Ingress, internal eu-central traffic, and all S3 API calls are free.
extras.chaining_verbatim: S3 origin; lowendtalk notes traffic to other Hetzner resources within the same region is free, so egress can be laundered through a Hetzner Cloud VM with its own included transfer — a legally-in-TOS route to far more than 1 TB/month.
extras.tooling_verbatim: AWS CLI, rclone, all S3 SDKs
extras.price_verbatim: $8.06/TB at 5 TB stored + 5 TB egress (EUR 35.89 = $40.32); $8.21/TB at 20 TB stored + 20 TB egress (EUR 146.16 = $164.19). Roughly 3.6x the Storage Box for the same bytes.
extras.agent_focus: Cheap-paid lane: S3-compatible object storage outside AWS/Azure/GCP/Alibaba/Cloudflare/B2/IDrive-e2. Target = true $/TB/month floor with free-or-generous egress, computed at the 5 TB and 20 TB tiers. EUR->USD at 1.1234 (frankfurter.app, 2026-10-21).
